d: National Security Advisor Ajit Doval addresses the 8th National Security Advisers Meeting of the Colombo Security Conclave in Maldives. He said, 'I am very confident that with the type of cooperation and the spirit with which we are working, at some time, we will be really able to make it a very powerful and effective instrument in the Indian Ocean Region that can provide collective security and also look after our interests.
